ask.title: Ask
ask.heading: What do you need?

ask.locationRequired: Location access is needed for this request. Enable location services and try again.

sites.empty: No sites can answer that request yet. Go back and try a different one.

errors.datetime: Enter a date and time as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Sign in to {{host}}; the window closes by itself.

results.title: Results
results.missing: This run is missing its request. Start over from Ask.
results.unsupported: Streaming results are not available on this platform yet.
results.signInNeeded: This site refused the request without signing in.

history.title: History
history.empty: No runs yet. Your past requests will appear here.

settings.title: Settings
settings.apiKeysDescription: Run requests with your own AI provider key

apiKeys.title: API Keys
apiKeys.cloudDescription: raidr runs your request. No key needed.
apiKeys.localDescription: Your request is planned by your chosen AI provider using your own key. Site sign-ins stay on this device.
apiKeys.localDisabled: Save a key for at least one provider below to turn on Local.
apiKeys.orderNote: The top provider with a saved key is used; the others are fallbacks, tried in order. Drag the handle to reorder.
apiKeys.storageNote: Keys are kept in this device's secure storage and only shown masked.
apiKeys.removeMessage: Your {{provider}} key will be deleted from this device.
